title: TUI: two-pane view leaves stale terminal background
description: The browser's two-pane view does not clear the whole frame each draw, so characters from previous terminal contents (or a previous larger frame after resize) can linger in cells the widgets do not repaint. The ? help overlay already fixes this for its own area by rendering a Clear widget and a solid background first; apply the same full-frame clear to the two-pane view (and the search line).
